id: title:VojtechBartos:report out of credits instead of a repo picker

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a specific exception class and its detection to the Slack app workflow, allowing the system to distinguish a 402 credits-exhausted response from other agent failures and avoid offering a repository picker when the team has no AI credits.
review.reason: Adds a new exception class and its detection, and the workflow and activity changes to use it. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of distinguishing this specific error and the resulting user experience improvement is not independently verified; this relies on the implementation and the stated workflow change.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; only observations are recorded.
